name: events-wait
description: Long-poll for the NEXT matching Unity event, by contains (log substring; a list matches any) or marker (exact beacon name). Earlier events are skipped unless you pass sinceEventId taken before the trigger (tool reply, bridge-get-status lastEventId); a match fired just before the wait returns at once as firedBeforeWait. A tool whose reply has waitFor can wait itself: pass it awaitMs. timedOut:true is normal: read diagnostic if any, recover with events-check-since.

contains.description: Message substring (case-insensitive); a list matches any.

marker.description: Beacon name: logging MCPEventReachedLocation(<name>) plants it.

sinceEventId.description: Only events after this id. Capture from bridge-get-status before the trigger so events during it aren't missed.

includeRecentMs.description: Also match events from the last N ms (race look-back); keep small.

timeoutMs.description: Max ms before timedOut:true (a normal branch).

includeData.description: Include the event's structured data payload in the result.

includeBridgeState.description: Also attach bridge status to a matched reply (a timed-out one always has it).
